methods.coverage_files: tracked files at the tree matching that tree vitest.config.ts coverage include minus exclude; static, no coverage run
methods.db_hashes: raw-byte SHA-256 of data/bot.db, bot.db-wal, bot.db-shm; never opened through SQLite
methods.eslint: node eslint.js src --format json --output-file, per tree, in the export and the checkout
methods.fork_count: static TypeScript AST count; see test-counts.json
methods.post_rail_count: vitest list per project in the main checkout
methods.pre_rail_count: git archive export of phase_start_sha, junctioned node_modules, no env file but the tracked example and sentinel, no data folder, scrubbed env and rails preload via spawnRailedChild (D-13)
methods.tree_hash: sha256 over sorted relpath\tsize\tmtimeMs lines of node_modules, excluding .vite, .vite-temp, .cache: Vitest and Vite write these caches during `vitest list`; they are not part of the installed dependency tree, so including them would make the NAC-08 hash change on every run (RESEARCH STL-2).
